en.Text:
The mod has finally re-released! Prepare for a slightly higher quality adventure than before, with hopefully far fewer issues.

New Content
- Completely remade Ancient Egypt, Lost City, and Wild West
- Expansions for Your House and partially Ancient Egypt
- Fighting Fire With Fire, Cratastrophe, and Hayride Escape (World Quests)
- Tombastic Adventures, Thorny Redemption, So Retro, and Peawitched (Epic Quests)

en.Text: The mod had its initial bugged release, broken so badly that it had to be remade from scratch and a beta build had to be released instead. Contained basic contents like Ancient Egypt's 10 main levels, Night Wild West which turned out to be a horrible idea, and Lost City.
